assumptions: no active cooling over the fitted segments and over the forecast horizon
room air behaves as one well-mixed node at the sensor (no stratification, no product lag)
no unrecorded internal loads (lights, people, defrost heaters, fans) that change over time
door openings and loading are absent or recorded as disturbances, not modelled
the ambient sensor measures the space the room exchanges heat with (NOT_VERIFIED from data)
over the horizon ambient stays at its last measured value unless future_ambient_c is given

conditional_on: no active cooling from the origin (the question asked)
held at its last measured value, the same rule the held-out forecasts used
no unrecorded disturbance beyond those seen in held-out data

limitations: Answers one question: room-air temperature at the sensor if there is NO active cooling from the origin. It is not a forecast of normal thermostat cycling.
Parameters are EFFECTIVE values for this room and period; they are not measured physical properties and do not transfer to another room.
Checked on SIMULATED data only; no real-room accuracy is claimed. Outputs from real logs are EXPECTED, never REAL, until an outcome confirms them.
No calibrated prediction interval is given (Phase 5). Profile ranges are identifiability checks only.
Door openings, loading, defrost and internal loads are not modelled (no such inputs); they appear only as unexplained disturbances or as fit error.

model.fallback_reason: first_order_measured_ambient was used; more physically informative alternatives: first_order_varying_ambient NOT_APPLICABLE
model.name: first_order_measured_ambient
model.selection_reason: held-out MAE at 30 min over 13 common cases: first_order_measured_ambient 0.077 °C, first_order_fitted_equilibrium 0.077 °C, recent_slope 0.104 °C, persistence 0.423 °C. Selected: the simplest method applicable at the origin within 0.02 °C of the lowest (first_order_measured_ambient)
model.solution_method: analytic: T(t) = E + (T0 - E) exp(-k t)

provenance.method: Phase 4 thermal engine + Phase 5 reliability assessment

question: NO_COOLING

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: defrost start/end from the controller or its event log; supply as an event log (kind, start, end, provenance)
recommendations.rationale: without defrost records such disturbances cannot be separated from the room's own behaviour and are never attributed to a cause

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: door contact switch on each door (open/close timestamps); supply as an event log (kind, start, end, provenance)
recommendations.rationale: without door open records such disturbances cannot be separated from the room's own behaviour and are never attributed to a cause

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: supply metadata: sensor id, column, location, height
recommendations.rationale: the analysed sensor's position is unknown, so what its readings represent cannot be stated

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: electrical power meter on the condensing unit
recommendations.rationale: a binary compressor state gives no power: b stays an effective °C/min

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: a product-simulant probe and a loading log (mass, entry temperature, time)
recommendations.rationale: product thermal mass and loading are absorbed into the effective k and E; they cannot be modelled separately

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: RH sensors inside and in the adjacent space
recommendations.rationale: latent loads and coil frosting cannot be assessed

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: keep logging through more passive periods (compressor OFF cycles or recorded outages)
recommendations.rationale: an interval at 80% needs 9 passive periods in each of calibration and evaluation (has 1 and 0); cases and windows inside one period do not count separately
recommendations.retry_conditions: >= 9 passive periods in each of calibration and evaluation

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: record more OFF cycles or outages
recommendations.rationale: all held-out evidence comes from too few separate passive periods to separate period-to-period variation from noise

recommendations.acquisition_guidance: record where the log comes from: REAL only for a physical logger's export, SIMULATED only for generated data
recommendations.rationale: the log's origin is unknown (UNVALIDATED), so it is treated neither as measurements nor as a simulation
recommendations.retry_conditions: a log with recorded provenance (REAL or SIMULATED)

regime_evidence: compressor recorded OFF at the origin, continuously for 190.0 min (191 reading(s), lines 457-647)

reliability.method: rule-based evidence gate (no score): status = most restrictive cap among failed rules

scenario: no active cooling from 2026-10-20 12:00:00 for 30 min (ASSUMED scenario)
equilibrium 25.00 °C over the horizon (ASSUMED: ambient held at its last measured value 25.00 °C (OBSERVED at line 647; steady over the last 60 min))
